title: 第16章 婆婆，求你当家
novel_title: 七零老太随军，海岛养崽当家做主
content_zh:
这会两口子已经回来了，就站门口翘首以盼呢。

    一群糙汉子瞧见赵玉兰就不再往前，纷纷放下驮在脖子上兄妹三个，这就打算走了。

    魏建业喊着：“都回来听事儿，我上主岛时接到消息，今年估摸着还有最后一个台风。”

    蔡老太和赵玉兰拎着两桶生蚝往灶房里头走。

    赵玉兰拿起来瞅瞅又闻闻，觉得腥了就放下，“妈，这是啥啊？”

    老家菜市场的活鱼都得要票，还不一定能买到，品种更是少得可怜，这玩意没见过啊。

    蔡老太拿菜刀撬开生蚝，给儿媳妇做了个示范，“这叫生蚝，你就这么撬开洗洗，回头上锅蒸个一两分钟就能吃。”

    赵玉兰寻思应该能算是肉吧，那今儿可就太丰盛了。

    她赶紧掀开铝饭盒，“妈，这地儿居然没有国营饭店，但是能进边防所食堂吃饭，这红烧肉是七毛钱一碗带一张粮票。”

    她是一定要交代清楚的，毕竟搁老家的黑市，一张粮票价值两毛钱呢，所以这一碗红烧肉相当于一块钱。

    甭说是结婚生子后的生活，就是从小到大她都没有做主过那么大的菜金啊。

    红烧肉可香，把三孩子馋得直吸溜口水。

    蔡老太往外头一指，“去洗手。”

    话出口她就意识到这相当于给小孩正大光明玩水的机会，又赶紧追出去，徒留赵玉兰还在喊：“妈，我买这肉成不成啊，妈，妈啊？”

    婆婆不给个准信她没底啊。

    这要是像以前，婆婆给多少钱她就买多少钱的东西，不就没这烦恼了吗？

    所以婆婆啊，往后别再说不当家的话好吗，怪折寿的！

    此时蔡老太已经溜达到门外，余光瞥着兄妹三。

    现在条件艰苦，她本来是怕孩子霍霍水，结果龙凤胎就是装模作样的伸手在水缸上方晃了晃，然后做搓手状。

    还知道演戏演全套，末了还要甩甩手。

    总之就是水一点没少，动作也一点都没落下，手更是一点都没洗，主打一个好像很听话，但实际又很不听话。

    心虚的时候，两孩子眼神绝对不往亲奶奶身上瞟一眼。

    蔡老太干咳一声，龙凤胎立刻转身，重新舀水蹲下来洗手。

    小老太也正听好大儿说工作上的事，那台风可大可小呢。

    她听着都是些工作内容，无非就是检测了将近一个星期，大概率确实是有台风的可能，美丽国那传来卫星云图，这事就这么敲定了。
content_en:
By now the couple had returned and were standing at the door eagerly awaiting their arrival.

A group of rough guys stopped moving forward when they saw Zhao Yulan. They put down the three brothers and sisters carrying them on their necks and planned to leave.

Wei Jianye shouted: "Come back and listen to what happened. When I went to the main island, I received news that there is probably the last typhoon this year."

Mrs. Cai and Zhao Yulan walked into the kitchen carrying two buckets of oysters.

Zhao Yulan picked it up, looked at it and smelled it, then put it down when she felt it was fishy, "Mom, what is this?"

You have to pay a ticket for live fish at the vegetable market in my hometown, and you may not always be able to buy it, and the varieties are very few. I have never seen anything like this before.

Mrs. Cai used a kitchen knife to pry open the oysters and gave her daughter-in-law a demonstration, "These are called oysters. Just pry them open and wash them. Then put them in the pot and steam them for a minute or two before you can eat them."

Zhao Yulan thought that it should be regarded as meat, so it would be too rich today.

She quickly opened the aluminum lunch box and said, "Mom, there are no state-owned restaurants here, but you can eat in the canteen of the border defense station. This braised pork is only 70 cents a bowl with a food stamp."

She must explain clearly. After all, on the black market in her hometown, a food stamp is worth 20 cents, so this bowl of braised pork is equivalent to one yuan.

Not to mention the life after getting married and having children, even since she was a child, she has never had such a large amount of money.

The braised pork is so fragrant that it makes the three children salivate.

Mrs. Cai pointed outside and said, "Go and wash your hands."

As soon as the words came out of her mouth, she realized that this was equivalent to giving the child an opportunity to play in the water openly, and hurriedly chased her out, leaving Zhao Yulan still shouting: "Mom, can I buy this meat? Mom, mom?"

If her mother-in-law doesn't give her a sure idea, she won't know.

If it were like before, if she could buy whatever her mother-in-law gave her, wouldn't she have this worry?

So, mother-in-law, please don’t say anything inappropriate about yourself in the future, okay? It’s your fault for shortening your life span!

At this time, Mrs. Cai had already walked outside the door and glanced at the three siblings from the corner of her eye.

Now that the conditions are difficult, she was originally afraid that her child would be in trouble, but in the end, the twins just pretended to reach out and wave their hands above the water tank, and then made a gesture of rubbing their hands.

I also know how to perform a full set of acting, but at the end I have to give up.

In short, the water is not missing at all, the movements are not slow at all, and the hands are not washed at all. The main character seems to be obedient, but in fact he is very disobedient.

When they feel guilty, the two children will never glance at their grandmother.

Mrs. Cai coughed dryly, and the twins immediately turned around, scooped up water again and squatted down to wash their hands.

The little old lady was also listening to the elder brother talk about work matters, whether the typhoon was big or small.

She heard that it was all about work, and it was nothing more than testing for nearly a week. There was a high probability that there was indeed a typhoon. Satellite cloud images came from the beautiful country, and the matter was finalized.
title_en: Chapter 16 Mother-in-law, please take charge of the family
